newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African rand ends three cts firmer, bonds strong.
newsitem.headline: S.African rand ends three cts firmer, bonds strong.

text.p: 1400 GMT - Rand settles at 4.5820/5870 on dollar after gaining three cents from Friday finish. Bonds little changed from noon levels after moving sideways in quiet afternoon trade.

* Dollar selling by local exporters and offshore players helps rand to two-month high of 4.5775 amid expectations that currency will hit 4.55 by weekend. Small amounts of importer demand surface around 4.58 but firmer trend seen continuing on Tuesday.

* Key R150 last at 15.39 pct from 15.49 pct on Friday. Dealers say foreigners continue to buy heavily into local market with domestic players also taking stock. Seen targetting 15.32 pct followed by 15.25 which dealers say a crucial level and could herald move to lower 14.00 percent levels. Short-end yields also fall amid good demand.
